title: Define the evaluation unit and host re-evaluation in the acceptance-evaluation contract
outcome: Define the evaluation unit and host re-evaluation in the acceptance-evaluation contract
acceptance: docs/features/acceptance-evaluation.md has a section that defines the evaluation unit (one item's run at one work revision and one source revision), states that a new whole record is required whenever the newest record is stale or does not pass everywhere, and states that the core never stitches per-criterion verdicts across records and that every verdict in a new record is a fresh judgment of all evidence up to that record's cut, where an earlier rationale may be quoted but never stands in for the judgment

the same section states the host contract for producing that record without a new session when nothing but evidence changed: re-evaluation in the same evaluator session under a fresh attempt key with refreshed criteria, bases, source and policy; a moved source needs a whole new inspection; a resubmit refusal is answered by re-reading the evidence and never by silently advancing the cut; one evaluator may serve items delivered together with per-item attempts and receipts; the first brief is the host's and parent text is attributed context

the section states what the numbers of 2026-09-29 support and what they do not (fewer new sessions, not fewer judgments), and the change is docs only with the link check and the AGENTS/CLAUDE identity check passing; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are not edited, because 'a small correction stays on the held item' is already stated in Required Quality Gates

completion.summary: Documented the evaluation unit, fresh whole-record re-evaluation, independent evaluator-session reuse, moved-source and R3b handling, per-item batching, host-authored briefs, and the qualified 2026-09-29 repeat-run findings.
